type_gate.invocation_shape: per-file tsgo subprocess for .sail controllers; one tsgo -p per TypeEnv for project .ts (no incremental program reuse)

canary_compare.note: same driver as LAYOUT-1 canary; compare against compile-path layout_ms

tokens.note: measured `tokens_generate::generate` into a temp dir; product HMR does not call this

does_rerun: per-file tsgo type-gate (new subprocess; cache miss on edit)
deck emit_build_warnings → check_all (layout/lint again; type-gate cache hit)
should_rerun: structural + lint of the changed file
type-gate of the changed region with program reuse
emit of the changed file + importer graph
should_not_rerun: second full collect() after a successful compile
